value.rationale: Bistar two-community networks pose a motivated one-link spreading intervention. It is not predetermined whether short redundancy or long-cycle coverage is optimal. A universal cubic phase boundary, no other optimizer, and all ties give a complete natural classification over every leaf-size imbalance and transmissibility; it directly supports sensitivity to infectiousness in link design without claiming empirical policy validation.
